private: the client's Authorization header is forwarded to the engine
X-TL-* headers are copied from the client and the key's priority only fills a gap
traceparent is not sent upstream
streams are forwarded without stream_options.include_usage
a stream that ends without [DONE] is a success
an error event inside a stream is read as an ordinary chunk
the usage chunk (choices: []) is not kept in the summary
a comment line (: ping) is an error
only 'data: ' with a space is accepted
X-Request-Id is not sent upstream
a non-2xx answer is parsed as a completion
Retry-After is not read on a 429
tokenize sends input instead of text
a text completion's choices[0].text is never read
only X-TL-Priority is stripped from the client; a forged X-TL-KV-Handle is forwarded
the error's code is dropped
content chunks are not counted
the stream's finish_reason is not kept
the token count is off by one
a trailing slash in Base doubles the slash
